description: A static list element in a generated block can't use the iterator
notes: The README lets the attributes of generated blocks use the iterator, and the spec's static list analysis gives the element expressions to be evaluated. hashicorp/hcl only puts the iterator in scope when the whole attribute is evaluated: static analyses unwrap the attribute's expression (exprWrap.UnwrapExpression in ext/dynblock/expr_wrap.go) and give the element expressions, which are then evaluated without it.
